```{r setup, include=FALSE}
  collapse = FALSE,
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.height = 4

```

## Text

This is a paragraph of body text, including **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, `inline code`, and a [link](https://www.r-project.org/).
Inline math $E = mc^2$, and a footnote[^1].

[^1]: The footnote will be rendered at the end of the document.

- Unordered list
- Second item
  - Nested item
1. Ordered list
2. Second item

> Blockquote. The theme's callout syntax (`> [!note]`) is not specially handled under pandoc and will only render as an ordinary blockquote.

## Math

Display equation:

$$
\int_0^1 x^2\,\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{3}
$$

Multi-line alignment:

$$
\begin{aligned}
a &= b + c \\
d &= e + f
\end{aligned}
$$

## Code

```{r}
summary(cars$speed)
```

Other languages work too; highlighting is handled by pandoc:

```bash
git clone git@github.com:2b-creator/AstroPapeR.git
```

## Plot

```{r cars-plot, fig.cap = "Speed and stopping distance", fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4}
plot(cars, pch = 19, col = "#006cac", main = "cars")
```

## Notes

- This file uses the theme via `output: astropaper::astropaper`; Knit it to produce the final output.
- Math uses KaTeX; fonts and KaTeX are loaded from CDNs, so viewing requires an internet connection.
- To append your own styles, add `css: ["custom.css"]` in the YAML.
